notes.title: Announcing Aphelion, DON'T NOD’s new sci-fi adventure!
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to present [i]Aphelion[/i], DON’T NOD’s newly announced sci-fi action-adventure game!  [/p][p]Set in a near-future where Earth faces collapse, [i]Aphelion[/i] is an emotional journey to the edge of our Solar System to survey a planet that may be humanity’s last hope. Our latest tale follows two European Space Agency astronauts: Ariane Montclair and Thomas Cross. Following their crash landing on the uncharted planet Persephone, they must brave harsh landscapes, master survival tools, gather crucial information, and navigate reality-bending phenomena in a desperate mission to reunite. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the reveal trailer:  [/p][previewyoutube="GqvbEVNTcPo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Aphelion[/i] blends our signature emotional storytelling with immersive exploration and traversal, mystery, and tense stealth gameplay. What begins as a totally compromised mission becomes an adventure into the unknown. As you explore the frozen world of Persephone, you’ll gather information on the planet’s strange conditions and what could’ve caused the crash of Ariane and Thomas’s ship, the Hope 01. [/p][p][b]A game in collaboration with the European Space Agency[/b] [/p][p]We’re also super honored to announce that the game is developed in collaboration with the European Space Agency (ESA)! Ariane and Thomas are both ESA astronauts, part of the fictional Hope 01 mission to survey a new potential home for humanity. We’re grounding our depiction of space exploration in real scientific knowledge and humanistic values. This very cool collaboration weaves authentic elements of space science into the emotional core of the game.  [/p][p]After all, this isn’t just a game about a planet. It’s a very human tale of how we behave when all hope is lost, and what keeps us going. [/p][p][i]Aphelion[/i] will launch in 2026 but you can wishlist it right now! [/p][p]To keep up with news on the game, follow us on [url="https://twitter.com/DONTNOD_Ent"][u]X[/u][/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/dontnod_ent/"][u]Instagram[/u][/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@dont_nod"][u]TikTok[/u][/url]! [/p]

notes.title: Our latest adventure game, Koira, is out now!
notes.notes:
Koira, a wholesome adventure game developed by Studio Tolima, is out now on Steam! Koira is a heartwarming, hand-drawn adventure featuring a lost forest spirit and her new puppy friend. Together they must journey to safety in the heart of the enchanted forest, solving puzzles, finding friends, and avoiding the hunters lurking along the way. 

Until April 14, you can get a 10% discount as a launch celebration on both the base game and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51550/Koira__Support_The_Devs_Bundle]Support the Devs Bundle[/url], which includes the game and 10 pieces of extra concept art that you can use as wallpapers on your devices.

[previewyoutube=Z1ortCeG5lU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Harmony is 70% Off for Visual Novel Fest!
notes.notes:
Harmony: The Fall of Reverie is a part of the Steam Visual Novel Fest this year, which runs until March 10 – so until then, you can grab the game at [b]70% off[/b]!  

Harmony is a beautiful, intricate, and innovative game where you play as Polly and Harmony, an oracle who meets gods and travels realms. Use your abilities as oracle to see into the future and determine the consequences of your actions – before you take them. 

It’s a vibrant and soulful tale with a loveable cast of fully voiced characters with themes such as connection, change, hope, and balance. So if you’re in the mood to change the world, this is the perfect game.

notes.title: Announcing The Lonesome Guild, Coming This Fall!
notes.notes:
We’re so pleased to announce The Lonesome Guild, a top-down single-player ARPG coming out of Turin, Italy’s Tiny Bull Studios. Announced exclusively at the ID@Xbox IGN FanFest, it’s the next game to be published by DON’T NOD and will release later this year!  

The Lonesome Guild is a tale of friendship, hope, and the strength found in togetherness. In a world consumed by loneliness, only friendship can save the day. Lead a quirky cast in this colorful ARPG full of heart, battles, and bonds that change everything. 

[previewyoutube=dQWc-2nEqNE;full][/previewyoutube]

You’ll play as Ghost, a spirit with no memories, in a world consumed by loneliness. As a creeping mist spreads, corrupting all in its path, you must gather a ragtag party of six misfits, each with unique abilities, stories, and struggles. Seamlessly switch between them in battle and exploration, forging bonds that unlock powerful combos and heartfelt moments by the campfire. Enjoy dynamic combat, puzzle-solving, and a world brimming with secrets. 

You can wishlist it now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486450/The_Lonesome_Guild/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486450/The_Lonesome_Guild/ [/url]

notes.title: Our newest game, Lost Records: Bloom & Rage, is out now!
notes.notes:
We’re so pleased to let you know that Tape 1 of DON’T NOD’s newest narrative adventure game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902960/Lost_Records_Bloom__Rage/]Lost Records: Bloom & Rage[/url], is out now! And if you grab it before March 4, you’ll benefit from the 10% launch discount! 

Rewind back to the 90s and live the defining summer of four high school girls as they forge bonds through their growing friendship, their punk band, and an unexplained event that will forever change their lives. 

If you enjoy narrative games and liked the complex and beautiful relationships in Harmony: The Fall of Reverie, we think you’ll love the friendship of Swann, Nora, Autumn, and Kat in Lost Records: Bloom & Rage.  

Watch the launch trailer: 

[previewyoutube=fnKGMAsh_xM;full][previewyoutube=fnKGMAsh_xM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Harmony: The Fall of Reverie - Patch 1.02 (July 2023)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We hope you have been enjoying Harmony: The Fall of Reverie so far!

You will find below a non-exhaustive list of things we have implemented in this patch.

[b]New features :
[/b]
· Added the possibility to check the paths you took on all Acts, with a short reminder of what happened

· Added the possibility to reload an Act you previously played once the game finished.

· Added a Tutorial menu in the Pause menu that gathers everything you need to know about the gameplay

· Added various Accessibility & Controls settings in Game settings

· Language option is now available in Game settings

· Added Nodes Barriers opening effects

· Added Gamma tweaking setting

· Added more narrative sounds in playlets

· Added a control rebinding menu for keyboards

· Added controls reminder for controllers

[b]Bugfixing :[/b]

· Fixed UI issues with specific keyboards

· Fixed various typos

· Fixed various issues on the Augural

Should you encounter issues or have any question, please check [url=https://support.dont-nod.com/hc/en-gb/articles/9834942100381-Harmony-The-Fall-of-Reverie-General-information]our dedicated FAQ [/url] or [url=https://support.dont-nod.com/hc/en-gb/requests/new]contact us[/url] if you need further assistance.

notes.title: Announcing Harmony: The Fall of Reverie, coming this June!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce our new narrative experience, Harmony: The Fall of Reverie! The game will be released this June and you can check out the reveal teaser right now: 

[previewyoutube=Wv5fBHVk7Pc;full][url=]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wv5fBHVk7Pc[/url][/previewyoutube]

See into the future and make the best decisions for you as you try to restore balance between our world and Reverie, the world of the deities. You will get to know a cast of loveable characters in this captivating story and universe rich in lore. The game is colorful, vibrant, and futuristic, with an original soundtrack by award-winning composer, Lena Raine. 

We can’t wait to tell you more about it, so follow us on social media to keep up to date!
